mapper.select: SELECT b.sku_id AS skuId, b.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, b.unit AS stockUnit, b.avg_cost AS stockUnitCost, CASE WHEN s.sale_unit = b.unit THEN 1.0000 ELSE conversion.stock_units_per_sale_unit END AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit, b.version AS balanceVersion FROM xsy_inventory_balance b JOIN xsy_product_sku s ON s.id = b.sku_id AND s.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion conversion ON conversion.sku_id = b.sku_id AND conversion.sale_unit = s.sale_unit AND conversion.stock_unit = b.unit AND conversion.deleted = FALSE WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND b.sku_id IN #{skuId}
